import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
palette = {'Normal': '#2ecc71', 'Overweight': '#f39c12', 'Normal Weight': '#3498db', 'Obese': '#e74c3c'}
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                          hue='BMI Category', palette=palette, alpha=0.7, s=60, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', loc='lower right')

# Plot 2: Average Sleep Quality by Occupation
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
occupation_sleep = df.groupby('Occupation')['Quality of Sleep'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(occupation_sleep))
bars = ax2.barh(occupation_sleep.index, occupation_sleep.values, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Quality of Sleep', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Quality by Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlim(0, 10)
# Add value labels
for bar, val in zip(bars, occupation_sleep.values):
    ax2.text(val + 0.1, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'{val:.1f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# Plot 3: Stress Level vs Physical Activity with Sleep Disorder indication
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df['Sleep Disorder Clean'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
markers = {'None': 'o', 'Insomnia': 's', 'Sleep Apnea': '^'}
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder Clean'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Sleep Disorder Clean'] == disorder]
    ax3.scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Stress Level'], 
                label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=50, marker=markers.get(disorder, 'o'))
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Stress Level vs Physical Activity\n(by Sleep Disorder Status)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', loc='upper right')

# Plot 4: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', palette=['#3498db', '#e91e63'], ax=ax4)
sns.stripplot(data=df, x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', color='black', alpha=0.3, size=3, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Add summary statistics as text
for i, gender in enumerate(['Female', 'Male']):
    gender_data = df[df['Gender'] == gender]['Sleep Duration']
    stats_text = f'μ={gender_data.mean():.1f}h\nσ={gender_data.std():.1f}h'
    ax4.text(i, df['Sleep Duration'].max() + 0.2, stats_text, ha='center', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
